headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: PBT increased 15% YoY to INR 20,448 cr, while PAT grew 19% YoY to INR 15,397 cr, translating into H1FY27 EPS of INR 24.94.
On a quarterly basis, Q2FY27 revenue rose 20.9% YoY to INR 44,179 cr from INR 36,553 cr, while declining 4.5% QoQ from INR 46,255 cr.
EBITDA grew 28% YoY to INR 11,447 cr, with margin improving to 26% from 24% in Q2FY26.
Profit margin improved to 14.8% from 11.4% in Q2FY26 but moderated from 19.1% in Q1FY27.
